name: DCX Pipeline
aliases: Deep Marching Cubes Data Pipeline & Mesh Extraction
definition: A pipeline for converting point clouds to meshes using voxelization, cube type classification, thinning, and reconstruction, exposed via a Python binding module named DCX_main.
summary: The DCX Pipeline converts volumetric inputs into explicit surface meshes by learning discrete topology classes and continuous vertex offsets per voxel, distinguishing itself by explicitly predicting topology to control mesh connectivity.
